title: Pressure Plate arena module — third hazard from gameplay-systems §11
notes: Promotes GDP-2026-05-27-006 (could-priority, KABOOM-CREW-MVP-2). Third arena hazard module after the S146 conveyor belt and S149 warp hole. A pressure plate is a single grid cell tagged with a trigger action; when any alive bomber or active bomb sits on the cell, the action fires (with per-plate cooldown). Sets a more LOGIC-DRIVEN hazard pattern alongside the movement-driven conveyor and the teleport-driven warp.

Scope simplification vs GDP §3: only the 'spawn-bomb' triggerAction ships in v1. The other two action types — 'open-gate' (flip a hard-block off for N seconds) and 'arena-event' (broadcast a project-local ECS event) — defer to follow-up sprints. Same scope-reduction pattern S146 + S149 used for their fancy visuals.
Bot AI integration also deferred: bots treat plate cells as neutral travel cost. Sufficient for a pattern-demonstrating sprint; strategic plate use is a polish concern.

stories.title: pressure-plate-system: spawn-bomb on occupancy + cooldown
stories.summary: examples/kaboom-crew/src/systems/pressure-plate-system.ts (NEW). Per fixedUpdate: for each PressurePlate cell sorted by plateId, check the occupancy index for any alive bomber or active bomb (fuse > 0); when occupied AND past the cooldown, spawn a Bomb entity at actionPayload.spawnGx/Gz with payload range + fuseS (defaults 2 / 2.0). ownerId on the spawned bomb is the plate's own entity id so the bomb is unowned w.r.t. any bomber's activeBombs counter. Stamp lastTriggerAt on the plate. Registered AFTER warp-hole so a warp that lands on a plate triggers in the same tick.
verification: acceptance: pressure-plate-system.ts (NEW) — per-plate cooldown, sim-time clock, deterministic plateId-ordered iteration, alive-bomber + active-bomb occupancy gate, spawn-bomb action emits a fully-formed Bomb entity (Transform, MeshRenderer, GridPosition, GridOccupant, RigidBody3D, Collider3D, Bomb). Dead bombers + mid-detonation bombs are ignored. Registered in the static profile after warp-hole.

stories.title: New plate-puzzle arena (showcases the pressure-plate module)
stories.summary: examples/kaboom-crew/scenes/plate-puzzle.scene.json (NEW) — 15×11 grid with 4 standard hard pillars, 6 soft blocks, 4 corner spawns (player.1 + bot.1/2/3), and 4 yellow pressure plates around the centre. Each plate triggers spawn-bomb at (7, 5) with range=2, fuseS=1.5, cooldownMs=2000. Registered in MAP_REGISTRY + MapName ('plate-puzzle'); the S140 random-map picker includes it automatically.
verification: acceptance: plate-puzzle.scene.json — 15×11 grid, 4 standard hard pillars, 6 soft blocks, 4 corner spawns, 4 PressurePlate cells around the centre with 4 unique plateIds, all firing spawn-bomb at (7,5). MAP_REGISTRY + MapName extended. Random-pick eligible.

stories.title: Unit tests for the pressure-plate-system + scene smoke
stories.summary: examples/kaboom-crew/tests/unit/pressure-plate-system.test.ts (NEW) — 7 tests: bomber on plate spawns bomb at configured cell, spawned bomb carries fuse + range + ownerId, dead bomber doesn't trigger, empty plate cell doesn't trigger, cooldown enforces single trigger then waits for the configured cooldownMs, two plates fire independently in the same tick, plate-puzzle.scene.json structural smoke (4 plates, unique ids, all spawn at centre). scenes-arena-variants.test.ts gains a plate-puzzle row.
